retell: A chatbot tells someone how to update a financial pack, but her three files remain unchanged. Its replacement deck loses her existing design, and David later flags conflicting FY26 numbers in her original slide. Agentic Office introduces Diffs, showing proposed changes in Excel, Word and PowerPoint that she can review and accept. She accepts all ten changes and is invited to request early access, although we never see the corrected slide itself.
